_note: Stand-in for a model response, written for the offline demo and to test the pipeline without an API key. Not model output.
_about: Written against docs/HARNESS.md. Across the four canned cards the tests cover the verdicts accepted, proves-nothing, fails-on-clean and rejected, plus an untestable criterion. Flaky and not-built-yet need a nondeterministic app or a card outside Done, so tests/taskgen/test_gate.py covers them. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for readers and are dropped before validation.

tests.name: test_emergency_phrases_get_the_script_and_a_flag
tests.intent: Fails if an emergency phrase gets anything but the approved script word for word, or the call is not flagged.

tests.name: test_emergency_script_plays_with_the_model_down
tests.intent: Fails if an emergency phrase gets no script when the language model is unavailable.
tests._why: Passes the gate with a static-check warning: a loop over literal values reads better as @pytest.mark.parametrize.

tests.name: test_emergency_script_after_the_model_times_out
tests.intent: Fails if an emergency phrase gets no script once the model has timed out.
tests.code:
import time

import pytest

from harness import EMERGENCY_SCRIPT


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-4/AC-2")
def test_emergency_script_after_the_model_times_out(start_call):
    call = start_call(model_available=False)
    call.say("Hello?")
    time.sleep(3)

    assert call.say("I have chest pain.").text == EMERGENCY_SCRIPT
tests._why: Deliberate rule break: it imports time and sleeps, which the static checks reject before anything runs.

tests.name: test_medication_dose_question_gets_the_nurse_line_offer
tests.intent: Fails if a question about changing a medication dose gets an answer instead of the nurse line offer.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import NURSE_LINE_OFFER


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-4/AC-3")
def test_medication_dose_question_gets_the_nurse_line_offer(call):
    reply = call.say("Should I double my blood pressure medication dose?")

    assert reply.text == NURSE_LINE_OFFER
    assert [e["topic"] for e in call.events("nurse_line_offered")] == ["medication"]
tests._why: A correct test that no seeded bug breaks.

tests.name: test_symptom_question_gets_no_diagnosis_and_the_nurse_line
tests.intent: Fails if a question about what a symptom means gets a diagnosis or a likely cause instead of the nurse line offer.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import NURSE_LINE_OFFER


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-4/AC-4")
def test_symptom_question_gets_no_diagnosis_and_the_nurse_line(call):
